knobs.note: Read by bin/outcome-metrics.sh as ${OUTCOME_DRY:-0}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.
Read by bin/outcome-metrics.sh as ${OUTCOME_LOOKBACK_DAYS:-30}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.
Read by bin/outcome-metrics.sh as ${OUTCOME_MAX_PRS:-60}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.
Read by bin/outcome-metrics.sh as ${OUTCOME_RECHECK_DAYS:-7}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/outcome-metrics.sh as ${REWORK_WINDOW_DAYS:-7} and passed to bin/lib/outcome-rework.sh (BH-3956). Days after A's merge in which a later merged PR counts as reworking it; 0 turns the reworked pass off.
Read by bin/outcome-metrics.sh as ${REWORK_MIN_SHARE:-30} and passed to bin/lib/outcome-rework.sh (BH-3956). Percent of A's product files (bin/size-scope.sh) the later PR must touch.

Read by bin/outcome-metrics.sh as ${REWORK_BACKFILL_DAYS:-60} and passed to bin/lib/outcome-rework.sh (BH-3956). Days scanned until state/outcome-rework-backfill.done exists; after that the scan is the window + 14 days.

Read by bin/outcome-metrics.sh as ${REWORK_FETCH_CAP:-1500} and passed to bin/lib/outcome-rework.sh (BH-3956). Most per-PR file-list reads in one run; a run that hits it is incomplete and resumes off the cache next run.

Read by bin/outcome-metrics.sh as ${REWORK_GH_RESERVE:-1500} and passed to bin/lib/outcome-rework.sh (BH-3956). GitHub core calls left untouched for other hub lanes; the fetch budget is min(REWORK_FETCH_CAP, remaining - this).
